query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQD_DEFECT_DIE SELECT A.WAFER_SEQ TEST_WAFER_SEQ, A.DIE_NUM TEST_DIE_NUM, B.DM_STEP_SEQ, B.DEFECTID DM_DEFECTID, A.X, A.Y, A.BIN, B.CLASSNUMBER FROM ?? A, ( SELECT W.WAFER_SEQ TEST_WAFER_SEQ, I.STEP_SEQ DM_STEP_SEQ, TRUNC((((M.ORIGIN_INDEX_X * M.CHIP_SIZE_X) + M.ORIGIN_MICRO_X) + D.X) / M.CHIP_SIZE_X, 0) AS XINDEX, TRUNC((((M.ORIGIN_INDEX_Y * M.CHIP_SIZE_Y) + (M.CHIP_SIZE_Y - M.ORIGIN_MICRO_Y)) + D.Y) / M.CHIP_SIZE_Y, 0) AS YINDEX, D.DEFECTID, D.CLASSNUMBER FROM TQP_LOT L, TQP_WAFER W, TQC_LOT_STS S, TQP_MAPDEF M, TQD_INSP_INFO I, TQD_DEFECT D WHERE 1 = 1 AND L.FACTORY = W.FACTORY AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND L.FACTORY = M.FACTORY AND S.MASK_ID = M.MAPID AND S.LOT_NO = L.LOT_ID AND L.LOT_ID = I.LOT_ID AND I.SLOT_ID = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(W.WAFER_ID, INSTR(W.WAFER_ID,'-')+1)) AND M.DELETE_FLAG <> 'Y' AND I.STEP_SEQ = D.STEP_SEQ AND I.TEST = 1 ) B WHERE A.WAFER_SEQ = B.TEST_WAFER_SEQ AND A.X = B.XINDEX AND A.Y = B.YINDEX AND A.WAFER_SEQ = :test_wafer_seq

SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE OWNER = 'TPSMGR' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('X', 'Y', 'BIN') AND TABLE_NAME IN ( SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM TQP_DATA_TABLES WHERE PROGRAM = :program ) GROUP BY TABLE_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
DELETE FROM TQD_DEFECT_DIE WHERE 1 = 1 AND TEST_WAFER_SEQ = :test_seq

-- Create Date : 2019-11-12 21:22:40 SELECT TO_CHAR(T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY') AS "YEAR", TO_CHAR(T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP, 'MM') AS "MONTH", TO_CHAR(T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP, 'WW') AS "WW", T1.PRODUCT AS "DEVICE", T1.LOT_ID, T1.WAFER_ID, TO_CHAR(T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "INSPECTION_TIME", T1.STEP_ID, T4.PROGRAM, T4.NETDIE, T4.TESTED_DIE, T4.GEC, T4.YIELD, ?? FROM TQD_INSP_INFO T1, (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ, DECODE (GROUPING (CLASSNUMBER), 0, TO_CHAR (CLASSNUMBER), 'SUM') AS CLASSNUMBER, COUNT (CLASSNUMBER) CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.STEP_SEQ, T1.WAFER_SEQ, T2.XINDEX * 65536 + T2.YINDEX, T2.CLASSNUMBER FROM TQD_INSP_INFO T1, TQD_DEFECT T2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.STEP_SEQ = T2.STEP_SEQ AND T1.WAFER_SEQ = T2.WAFER_SEQ AND T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :FROMDATE, 'yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE ( :TODATE, 'yyyymmdd') AND T1.LOT_ID IN (??) AND T1.WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND T1.STEP_ID IN (??) AND T2.CLASSNUMBER IN (??)) GROUP BY STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ, ROLLUP (CLASSNUMBER)) PIVOT (SUM (CNT) FOR CLASSNUMBER IN (??))) T2, (SELECT T1.* FROM (SELECT TEST_WAFER_SEQ, DM_STEP_SEQ, CLASSNUMBER, CLASSNUMBER_CNT CNT FROM ( SELECT TEST_WAFER_SEQ, DM_STEP_SEQ, DECODE (GROUPING (CLASSNUMBER), 0, TO_CHAR (CLASSNUMBER), 'SUM') AS CLASSNUMBER, COUNT (CLASSNUMBER) AS CLASSNUMBER_CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT T2.TEST_WAFER_SEQ, T2.TEST_DIE_NUM, T2.DM_STEP_SEQ, T2.X * 65536 + T2.Y, T2.BIN, T2.CLASSNUMBER FROM TQD_INSP_INFO T1, TQD_DEFECT_DIE T2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.STEP_SEQ = T2.DM_STEP_SEQ AND T1.RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :FROMDATE, 'yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE ( :TODATE, 'yyyymmdd') AND T1.LOT_ID IN (??) AND T1.WAFER_SEQ IN (??) AND T1.STEP_ID IN (??) AND T2.BIN NOT IN (??) -- high gec AND T2.CLASSNUMBER IN (??)) WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY TEST_WAFER_SEQ, DM_STEP_SEQ, ROLLUP (CLASSNUMBER)) WHERE 1 = 1) PIVOT (SUM (CNT) FOR CLASSNUMBER IN (??)) T1 WHERE 1 = 1) T3, (SELECT DISTINCT T1.LOT_ID, CASE WHEN T1.WAFER_ID LIKE 'AK%' THEN SUBSTR (T1.WAFER_ID, 3) ELSE T1.WAFER_ID END AS WAFER_ID, T1.PROGRAM, DECODE(T1.NETDIE, NULL, T2.NETDIE, T1.NETDIE) AS NETDIE, T1.TESTED_DIE, T1.GEC, T1.YIELD FROM TQP_WAFER_SUM T1, TQP_MAPDEF T2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEVICE_ALIAS = T2.MAPID AND T1.TESTAREA IN ('MULTIPROBE') AND T1.PROBE_CNT = 0) T4 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.STEP_SEQ = T3.DM_STEP_SEQ(+) AND T1.LOT_ID = T4.LOT_ID AND T1.WAFER_ID = T4.WAFER_ID AND T1.STEP_SEQ = T2.STEP_SEQ AND T1.WAFER_SEQ = T2.WAFER_SEQ ORDER BY T1.WAFER_ID
